cards.ex: I love zipping around town on my scooter; it's so much faster than driving.
cards.exUz: Men skuterimda shaharni tez aylanib yurishni yaxshi ko'raman; mashinadan ko'ra ancha tezroq.
cards.uzDef: Tez va osonlik bilan bir joydan boshqa joyga borish, ayniqsa transportda.

cards.ex: The bike-sharing scheme has made it much easier to explore the city center.
cards.exUz: Velosiped ijarasi shahar markazini o'rganishni ancha osonlashtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Velosipedlarni qisqa muddatga ijaraga berish xizmati, odatda shaharlarda.

cards.ex: It can be tricky to navigate the city during peak hours due to the heavy traffic.
cards.exUz: Trafik tufayli shaharda soatlab yurish juda qiyin bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Shaharda yo'l topish va harakatlanish, odatda transport vositalari yordamida.

cards.ex: We arrived at the ferry terminal just in time to board the boat.
cards.exUz: Biz paromga chiqish uchun parom terminaliga o'z vaqtida yetib keldik.
cards.uzDef: Paromlar to'xtaydigan va yo'lovchilarni tushirib-ortadigan joy.

cards.ex: The new inner-city bypass has significantly reduced congestion in the city center.
cards.exUz: Yangi ichki aylanma yo'l shahar markazidagi tirbandlikni sezilarli darajada kamaytirdi.
cards.uzDef: Shahar markazidan o'tmaydigan yo'l, tirbandlikni kamaytirish uchun.

cards.ex: Road closures due to the marathon caused major delays this morning.
cards.exUz: Marafon tufayli yo'llarning yopilishi bugun ertalab katta kechikishlarga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Yo'llarning vaqtincha yopilishi, odatda ta'mirlash yoki tadbirlar tufayli.

cards.ex: I'm so tired of the daily grind; I wish I could work from home.
cards.exUz: Men kundalik tashvishdan juda charchadim; uyda ishlashni xohlardim.
cards.uzDef: Kundalik ish yoki maktabga borish bilan bog'liq mashaqqatli harakat.

cards.ex: Due to track maintenance, a rail replacement bus service will operate this weekend.
cards.exUz: Yo'lni ta'mirlash ishlari tufayli, bu hafta oxiri temiryo'l o'rniga avtobus xizmati ko'rsatiladi.
cards.uzDef: Poyezdlar o'rniga xizmat qiluvchi avtobus, ta'mirlash ishlari vaqtida.

cards.ex: I always try to get an aisle seat on long-haul flights so I can stretch my legs.
cards.exUz: Men har doim uzoq reyslarda oyoqlarimni cho'zish uchun yo'lak joyini olishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq masofaga uchadigan samolyot reysi.

cards.ex: We set off early in the morning to avoid the worst of the traffic.
cards.exUz: Biz tirbandlikning eng yomonidan qochish uchun erta tongda yo'lga chiqdik.
cards.uzDef: Sayohatni boshlamoq, bir joydan ketmoq.

cards.ex: That intersection is a real traffic bottleneck, especially during rush hour.
cards.exUz: Bu chorraha ayniqsa gavjum paytlarda haqiqiy tirbandlik nuqtasi.
cards.uzDef: Tirbandlik tez-tez yuzaga keladigan yo'l qismi.

cards.ex: Don't weigh yourself down with too much luggage; you'll have to carry it all.
cards.exUz: O'zingizni juda ko'p yuk bilan og'irlashtirmang; hammasini o'zingiz ko'tarishingiz kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Og'ir narsalar tufayli harakat qilishni qiyinlashtirmoq.

cards.ex: He is feathering the nest by investing in properties near the train station.
cards.exUz: U poyezd stantsiyasi yaqinidagi mulklarga sarmoya kiritish orqali kelajak uchun pul to'plamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kelajak uchun pul yoki narsalar to'plamoq, g'amxo'rlik qilmoq.

cards.ex: I dropped my daughter off at the kiss and ride outside the school.
cards.exUz: Men qizimni maktab tashqarisidagi qo'yib ketish joyida tushirib qoldirdim.
cards.uzDef: Yo'lovchini tushirib, mashinada ketish uchun mo'ljallangan joy.

cards.ex: More restaurants are offering curb-side pickup to avoid indoor dining.
cards.exUz: Ko'proq restoranlar ichkarida ovqatlanmaslik uchun yo'l chetida buyurtmani olib ketish xizmatini taklif qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yo'l chetida to'xtab, buyurtmani olib ketish xizmati.

cards.ex: Ride-hailing services have become increasingly popular in urban areas.
cards.exUz: Taksi chaqirish xizmatlari shahar hududlarida tobora ommalashib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Mobil ilova orqali taksi chaqirish xizmati.

cards.ex: We booked a car through a car rental agency for our vacation.
cards.exUz: Biz ta'tilimiz uchun mashina ijarasi orqali mashina buyurtma qildik.
cards.uzDef: Mashinalarni ijaraga beruvchi kompaniya.

cards.ex: The number 12 bus route goes directly to the university.
cards.exUz: 12-sonli avtobus yo'nalishi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri universitetga boradi.
cards.uzDef: Avtobus qatnaydigan yo'l.

cards.ex: My commute time is about 45 minutes each way.
cards.exUz: Mening qatnov vaqtim har tomonga taxminan 45 daqiqa.
cards.uzDef: Ishga yoki o'qishga borish uchun ketadigan vaqt.

cards.ex: There's a taxi rank right outside the train station.
cards.exUz: Poyezd stantsiyasining tashqarisida taksi to'xtash joyi bor.
cards.uzDef: Taksilar mijozlarni kutib turadigan joy.

cards.ex: Amsterdam is known as a bike-friendly city with many cycle paths.
cards.exUz: Amsterdam ko'plab velosiped yo'laklari bilan velosipedbop shahar sifatida tanilgan.
cards.uzDef: Velosipedda harakatlanish uchun qulay shahar.

cards.ex: The project finally got the green light to build a new railway line.
cards.exUz: Loyihaga nihoyat yangi temir yo'l liniyasini qurishga ruxsat berildi.
cards.uzDef: Ruxsat olmoq, tasdiqlanmoq (ko'chma ma'noda).

cards.ex: The accident happened on a major thoroughfare, causing significant delays.
cards.exUz: Baxtsiz hodisa katta yo'lda sodir bo'ldi va bu sezilarli kechikishlarga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Shahar yoki hudud bo'ylab asosiy yo'l.

cards.ex: The city is facing a parking crunch, especially in the downtown area.
cards.exUz: Shahar, ayniqsa shahar markazida to'xtash joyi tanqisligi muammosiga duch kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: To'xtash joylarining yetishmasligi muammosi.

cards.ex: They're planning a vacation to a remote island, completely off the grid.
cards.exUz: Ular uzoq orolga butunlay aloqasiz, dam olishni rejalashtirmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Elektr yoki internet kabi asosiy xizmatlardan uzilgan.

cards.ex: The city center is a car-free zone, making it pleasant for pedestrians.
cards.exUz: Shahar markazi mashinasiz hudud bo'lib, piyodalar uchun qulaydir.
cards.uzDef: Mashinalarga kirish taqiqlangan hudud.

cards.ex: With more people working remotely, we're seeing an increase in reverse commutes.
cards.exUz: Ko'proq odamlar masofadan turib ishlagani sababli, biz qarama-qarshi qatnovlarning ko'payishini kuzatmoqdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Shahardan chekka joylarga qatnash.

cards.ex: The pilot was a bit inexperienced and had to fly by the seat of his pants when the weather changed suddenly.
cards.exUz: Uchuvchi biroz tajribasiz edi va ob-havo birdan o'zgarganda tajribasiz harakat qilishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Tajribasiz va rejasiz harakat qilmoq (transport sohasida).

cards.ex: Before you buy a used car, make sure it's roadworthy and has passed inspection.
cards.exUz: Ishlatilgan mashinani sotib olishdan oldin, uning yo'lda harakatlanishga yaroqli va tekshiruvdan o'tganligiga ishonch hosil qiling.
cards.uzDef: Yo'lda harakatlanish uchun xavfsiz va yaroqli holatda.

cards.ex: The police used a rolling roadblock to slow down traffic during the parade.
cards.exUz: Politsiya parad vaqtida transport harakatini sekinlashtirish uchun harakatlanuvchi to'siqdan foydalangan.
cards.uzDef: Sekin harakatlanuvchi transport vositalari bilan yaratilgan to'siq.
